MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

3. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

4. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

5. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

6. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 7
   D. 15

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 13

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 23

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
